verdict: Leads down this week; Google spend produced zero results and is being addressed.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 133 leads at a cost of $16.49 per lead, entirely through Meta — Google Ads spent $501 and produced zero leads across the full period. In the most recent 7 days, lead volume dropped 35% and cost per lead rose 30%, driven by a pullback in Google spend that was already delivering nothing, and a near-complete stop in Google Business Profile activity. Meta is holding as the only working channel, though its daily lead rate has not yet confirmed a stable recovery. Google Ads spend is being redirected away from a zero-conversion setup, and infrastructure milestones — including landing pages and CRM build-outs — are being completed this month to support proper tracking and scale.

watch_item.issue: 154 leads entered the pipeline this period, but zero appointments were booked and zero were converted — leads are arriving but not being followed up into results.
watch_item.fix: The CRM and follow-up workflow is under review now, separate from ad performance, to close the gap between lead intake and actual bookings.
